purpose: Observable contract fixtures for the agent-first learning redesign.
note: These fixtures intentionally do not prescribe HTTP route names. The API contract is selected in T00 and implemented in T05.

stories.name: new_learner_intent_to_first_session

input.intent: I would like to learn music theory

must_create: at least one explanation or worked example
at least one diagnostic or practice activity
observable_checks: the learner can preview the promise and objectives
the learner can start and complete the first activity
the learner receives feedback and one primary next action
the browser can resume the journey after refresh

stories.name: journey_preview_and_adjustment

input.intent: I want to prepare for a beginner music theory exam

must_prove: each starter activity maps to an objective or skill
adjusting the goal changes the proposed package
an existing attempt is not rewritten by adjustment

stories.name: results_to_next_action
must_prove: shuffled multiple-choice options are graded and displayed correctly
the weak objective is supported by attempt evidence
the recommended activity can start without rebuilding the journey
the learner timeline contains both the completed and next activity

stories.name: agent_learner_co_pilot

input.intent: I want to learn web accessibility by improving a small site
input.subject: learner-d

must_prove: agent writes are attributed to the agent actor
all resources remain owned by the learner subject
the learner can read agent-created content
cross-owner reads and writes are rejected
revocation does not delete learner history

stories.name: self_host_public_origin
must_prove: the documented stack reaches its declared health or started state
the first learner story works through the Caddy origin
public documents agree between frontend and API delivery
the learner can resume after API or web restart

failure_cases.trigger: repeat the same onboarding request with the same idempotency identity
failure_cases.expected: return the existing bootstrap result without duplicate owner, journey, or activities

failure_cases.trigger: fail after goal creation and retry
failure_cases.expected: resume or safely complete the same journey without duplicate records
return an explicit reauthentication state without exposing another owner

failure_cases.trigger: disable the configured model/provider during bootstrap
failure_cases.expected: show resumable failure state and create no false learning progress

failure_cases.trigger: use one learner or agent credential against another learner's resource
failure_cases.expected: reject the operation and record the security-relevant attempt
